description: Configuración de cálculo con opciones y botones Editar/Cancelar/Guardar visibles
pre_capture_js: (() => { const css = document.createElement('style'); css.textContent = `gs-header, otto-web-side-panel, otto-web-solution-tool-bar { display: none !important; } .main_page { margin-left: 0 !important; width: 100vw !important; max-width: 100vw !important; } otto-web-layout-navigation, otto-web-managers-tabs-navigation { display: block !important; width: 100vw !important; } body, html { overflow: hidden !important; }`; document.head.appendChild(css); const tabs = document.querySelector('otto-web-managers-tabs-navigation > gs-tabs'); if (tabs) tabs.scrollIntoView({block: 'start', inline: 'nearest'}); })();
